0022600020.text: The Miami Heat (1-4, 0-3 at home) host the Indiana Pacers (2-3, 2-1 on the road) in Miami's sixth game of the season, with the Heat coming off a win and sitting 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 13th in the East, while the Pacers are on a two-game losing streak, 3rd in the Central, 2 games back, and 10th in the East. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami lost 1-2 to Indiana in 2025-26, including a 135-118 defeat in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026. Simone Fontecchio is out for the Heat with an illness, and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
